summary: Zenas BioPharma filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement replacing its October 8, 2025 at-the-market program with Jefferies as sales agent, establishing a new shelf takedown of up to $200.0 million of common stock under the Sales Agreement. Approximately $153.2 million had been sold under the prior supplement, which is terminated. Jefferies receives commissions up to 3.0% of gross proceeds; shares trade on Nasdaq under ZBIO, last at $28.46 on November 4, 2026. No escrow arrangement exists. This is a routine ATM shelf refresh, not a special situation; watch dilution pace and any accelerated selling into strength.
